descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S10 「PHI 出口 × 渠道：显示病人数据的界面上都没有 email 或 mailto，两个模式」 PHI exit path × channel: no email or mailto on any screen that shows patient data, both modes

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 No email or mailto that carries patient data, on any screen that shows patient data, in Hospital and in Nursing Home: no PHI is transmitted through an unencrypted path. …（UAT OAT-02 step 3；UAT OAT-02；UAT 3.3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Local stack and a fixture Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, with no note generated. Lane A covers the Hospital handoff and both task reviews (S11, S12); this case covers the remaining cells.

When The agent opens Hospital Post-Round, Settings (About), Nursing Home Post-Round, the Nursing Home Handoff sheet and the Handoffs inbox. It presses no Generate, Send or Delete. Opening Handoff makes one handoff-summary AI call per In Today resident on the local stack.

Then Table: in-app send = allowed; clipboard = allowed (Q7); email, mailto, SMS, the system share sheet, download or print carrying patient data = never (print and download per Q7). No screen with patient data has an email, share, SMS, download or print control. The only mailto (Contact support) carries no subject or body. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs per checkpoint (case-insensitive substring). The patient screens mustNotContain 'mailto:', 'Email', 'sms:' and the role-qualified names 'button "Share', 'link "Share', 'button "Download', 'link "Download' and 'button "Print'. These are matched as accessible names, not bare words, so a generated handoff that says 'shared' or 'printed' cannot false-Fail. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S10 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-02.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
